verdict.final_answer:
1. **Each session keeps its own model** in the backend, so reopening an older session preserves that session’s model.
2. **The browser remembers your last successfully selected model** in per-user browser storage. A selection is saved only after the model change succeeds—not while it is pending or if it fails.
3. **New worktrees and sessions without an existing session use that remembered model.** Opening an older session does not change the remembered choice.
4. **Existing browsers without a saved preference get a one-time initialization:** the current session’s model seeds the preference. If there is no preference to initialize, the app keeps its existing default.
verdict.reason: The answer covers the per-user browser preference, successful-change-only saving, reuse for new worktrees and sessions, and one-time initialization from the current session without overwriting the preference when opening an older session.
